policy: Late delivery guarantee: if your package is delivered more than 2 calendar days after the promised delivery date, we refund 100% of the order total. If the package never arrives, we also refund 100%. No exceptions apply.

We refund 50% of the order price when a delivery is more than 5 calendar days late. Lost or undelivered orders are handled through the carrier claims process and are not covered by this guarantee. Delays caused by weather are excluded.
Orders delivered more than 7 calendar days late, or not delivered at all, receive a full refund. Delays due to customs inspection are excluded from this guarantee.

Si tu pedido llega con mas de 3 dias naturales de retraso respecto a la fecha de entrega prometida, te devolvemos el 100 % del importe. Si el pedido no llega, tambien te devolvemos el 100 %. Esta garantia no tiene exclusiones.

Reembolsamos el 25 % del pedido si la entrega se retrasa mas de 10 dias naturales. Los pedidos no entregados no estan cubiertos por esta politica. Quedan excluidos los retrasos causados por la ausencia del destinatario en el momento de la entrega.
Deliveries that arrive more than 3 business days (Monday to Friday) after the promised date are refunded in full. Orders that are never delivered are also refunded in full. There are no exclusions.
We refund 100% of your order if it arrives more than 4 calendar days after the promised date, including weekends. Orders that never arrive are refunded 100% as well. No exclusions.

If your order is delivered more than 2 calendar days late, you get a 100% refund. If it is not delivered, you get a 100% refund. This guarantee does not apply to delays caused by customs clearance, severe weather, or an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the buyer.

We refund 100% when a delivery is more than 5 calendar days late, and 100% for orders that do not arrive. Excluded: events beyond our control such as natural disasters, strikes or war, and failed deliveries because the recipient was not at home.
We always do our best to deliver on time. If something goes wrong with your delivery, contact our support team and we will find a fair solution together.
Orders that arrive late may be eligible for a partial refund, at the store's discretion, depending on the circumstances of each case.

Late delivery: if your order arrives more than 3 calendar days late, we refund 100% of the order total. Orders that never arrive are refunded 100%. No exclusions apply.

Politica de reembolsos de TechShopping. Si el producto llega con fallas o no corresponde a la descripcion, reembolsamos el 100 % si nos escribe dentro de los 10 dias habiles posteriores a la entrega. Si el pedido no llega, reembolsamos el 100 % a partir de 5 dias habiles despues de la fecha estimada de entrega. Antes de pedir un reembolso, el comprador debe contactar a la tienda y darnos 48 horas para resolver el problema. No cubrimos pagos en efectivo.
